errors.evidence: The description states the chart shows 'Wohnstandortpräferenzen' (housing location preferences), which is an interpretation. The chart objectively shows the percentage share of households in different housing categories over time, not their preferences.
The description states the x-axis tick labels are in five-year intervals. However, the first interval, from 1984 to 1990, is a six-year interval.
For Line 2, the description states the value rises to 18% by 1990. The chart shows the value in 1990 is approximately 14%. It reaches a peak of around 18% later, in 1992.
For Line 2, the description claims the value falls to 10% by 1996. In 1996, the value is approximately 12%. The line hits a low of 10% in 1995.
For Line 2, the description states the value rises to 17% by 2005. The chart shows the value in 2005 is approximately 16%. It reaches a peak of around 18% in 2006.
For Line 3, the description claims the value rises to 16% by 1990. The chart shows the value in 1990 is around 12.5%. The line never reaches 16% at any point in the time series.
For Line 3, the description states the value rises to 14% by 2005. The chart shows the value in 2005 is approximately 12%. The line does not reach 14% after its initial peak around 1992.
The description incorrectly identifies the line style for Line 5 as 'gestrichelt' (dashed). The figure clearly shows a dotted line ('gepunktet').
